نرتئي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَئِي (nartaʔī) /nar.ta.ʔiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَأَى (irtaʔā)
# نَرْتَئِيَ (nartaʔiya) /nar.ta.ʔi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَأَى (irtaʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
